idea.title: What you get in a free listing review
idea.angle: I walk through the free listing review step by step: you send one listing's photos by WhatsApp, Instagram DM or text, I show how I'd turn it into a premium video and post, and some agencies get a free sample video.
idea.hook: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU SEND ME A LISTING

slides.heading: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU SEND ME A **LISTING**
slides.body: No filming. Nothing to pay. Here's exactly how the review works.

slides.heading: WOULD THIS WORK FOR **MY** LISTINGS?
slides.body: You've seen the tips. But you don't know if they'd work for your homes, your area, your buyers. So you wait.

slides.heading: WAITING KEEPS YOUR LISTINGS **INVISIBLE**
slides.body: Every week you wait, the same posts go out. A few likes, no messages. And you still don't know why.

slides.heading: SEND ME ONE **LISTING**
slides.body: Pick one current listing. Send it on WhatsApp, Instagram DM or text. That's all you do.

slides.heading: I CHECK WHAT **BUYERS** SEE
slides.body: Photo order, hook, basics and next step. I look at what makes buyers stop, and what makes them scroll past.

slides.heading: I SHOW YOU THE **PREMIUM** VERSION
slides.body: I show you how I'd turn it into a premium video and post. For some agencies, I make a free sample video too.

slides.heading: YOU SEND. I DO THE **REST**.
slides.body: If you like what you see, I make the videos, write the captions and post them. No filming. One extra rental a month covers it.

slides.heading: LET'S LOOK AT **YOUR** LISTING
slides.body: DM me REVIEW and I'll look at one of your listings

caption:
Not sure if this would work for your listings? Let me show you on one of them.

Send me one current listing on WhatsApp, Instagram DM or text.
I check what buyers see first: photo order, hook, basics and next step.
Then I show you how I'd turn it into a premium video and post.
For some agencies, I make a free sample video too. No filming, nothing to pay.

DM me REVIEW and I'll look at one of your listings.
